verdict.rationale: Web search that returns full page content is a fair axis for a crawling and extraction tool. However, the evidence only shows Crawl4AI crawling URLs the user supplies, deep crawls and query-driven adaptive crawling from a starting page. No web search endpoint or search-plus-scrape call is documented. Query-relevance filtering (BM25, cosine similarity) and adaptive crawling are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search the web and get full page content from results in a single call instead of just links and snippets
